question: In what intimate relation does the goddess stand to the worshipper of the supreme god?
premises: The goddess is identified as the very life of the worshipper of the god of gods.
The goddess is identified as beloved to that worshipper.
inference: She is both the vital essence and the cherished object of the supreme god's devotee.
plain_english: She is the life of the worshipper of the god of gods and beloved to that worshipper.
